component.name: ProbeItem
component.script:
sub init() m.label = m.top.findNode("title") m.name = "?" end sub
sub onContent() m.name = m.top.itemContent.title m.label.text = m.name m.top.getScene().callFunc("registerItem", {name: m.name, node: m.top}) end sub
sub onFocusPercent() m.top.getScene().callFunc("itemLog", m.name + ".focusPercent=" + Str(Int(m.top.focusPercent * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000).trim()) end sub
sub onHasFocus() v = "false" if m.top.itemHasFocus then v = "true" m.top.getScene().callFunc("itemLog", m.name + ".itemHasFocus=" + v) end sub
